cls.quote: This Class 2 e-bike features a 500W motor with a peak output of 750W, offering an ideal balance of power and road-legal performance. With a top speed of 20 mph, it delivers smooth, easy handling while prioritizing rider safety—making it a great choice for teens and everyday rides. ⟶ THE BATTERY MEETS RIGOROUS UL SAFETY STANDARDS.
The X7 is limited to 20 mph (32 km/h) on throttle, making it a legitimate Class 2 e-bike, not one of those gray-area “wink wink” bikes that blur the line into e-moto territory.

spd.quote: It’s capped at 20 mph (32 km/h), which keeps it firmly in Class 2 territory, but it gets there easily and holds speed well.

wh.quote: On paper, the Macfox X7 is fairly modest: a 500W motor with 750W peak output, paired with a 48V 13Ah battery, for a total capacity of 624 Wh.
